item.title: Jamaica’s Cannabis Reform Opens a New Path for Small Growers
item.dc:creator: Camila Berriex
item.description:
New licensing tiers let traditional ganja farmers in Jamaica sell to the legal market for the first time.

The post Jamaica’s Cannabis Reform Opens a New Path for Small Growers appeared first on High Times.
item.content:encoded:
New licensing tiers let traditional ganja farmers in Jamaica sell to the legal market for the first time, the Cannabis Licensing Authority said this week.

The reform follows years of complaints that the cost of a cultivation licence kept small farmers, many of them Rastafarians, out of the regulated industry.

The post Jamaica’s Cannabis Reform Opens a New Path for Small Growers appeared first on High Times.
